findings.title: Boundary scenario desired-move-in-date-too-far-future neutralized: {MOVE_IN_DATE} (today+90d) can never trigger the validation_error it asserts
findings.evidence: yaml:24 'desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}"' with expected_outcome: validation_error. SKILL.md:172 '{MOVE_IN_DATE} → today + 90 days'; SKILL.md:279 'Only the boundary-validation scenarios (desired-move-in-date-in-past, -too-far-future) pin literal dates on purpose.' application_handler.gleam:1114-1117 validates against today + 12-month ceiling.
findings.detail: The r2 staleness sweep replaced the pinned literal (2030-01-01) with the valid +90d template, contradicting SKILL.md's own carve-out and the scenario's yearly-maintenance note. Submission sails to confirmation; the scenario fails every run AND the 12-month upper bound loses its E2E pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Restore a literal out-of-window date (e.g. 2030-01-01) in this one scenario, per SKILL.md:279's carve-out.

findings.title: listing-source-tamper asserts a field-listing_source-error span that F4 removed from the render — scenario can never pass

findings.detail: The tamper_hidden_inputs rework converted the injection but left expected_error_fields pointing at an inline span the field diet deleted. Server still rejects (whitelist + DB CHECK intact), but the harness's second assertion is unsatisfiable — the rewritten scenario fails every run.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert the rejection via the error-summary row text ('Where did you find this listing?') instead of the inline span, or extend the harness with a summary-field assertion mode for fields no longer rendered.

findings.title: SKILL.md documents {MOVE_IN_DATE} generation with BSD-only `date -v+90d`

findings.detail: Fine on the macOS dev machines the suite runs on today; bites the first Linux runner.
findings.recommended_fix: Note both forms in the parenthetical.
